id: 16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co
title: 认识气体和气瓶
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/16_Laboratory Safety Training on Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Liquids Training Co/src.py

points.K3: 非液化气体：始终是气体
points.K4: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
points.K7: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
points.K8: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
points.K9: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
points.K10: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
points.K11: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
points.K12: 减压阀和压力表要配套
points.K13: 认识之后，才谈安全使用
points.S2: 气体管路标明名称和流向

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在几只不同形状的气瓶和一个低温罐旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside several gas cylinders of different shapes and a small cryogenic dewar, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识气体和气瓶。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 三个气体形态图标和三个气瓶外形图标
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of icons: three gas state icons on top and three container shape icons below. No people.
shots.narration: 气体分三类，气瓶也分三种。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰指着一只细高气瓶和一只矮胖气瓶，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a tall narrow cylinder and a short fat cylinder, looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：气瓶为什么有高有矮？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李笑着走过来，拍拍一只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smiles, walks over and pats the shoulder of a chained cylinder.
shots.narration: 老李说：装的气不一样，瓶子就不一样。

shots.section_title: 压缩气体分三类
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现三个图标：液滴、气体云、溶解在液体里的气泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a liquid drop, a gas cloud, and gas bubbles dissolved in a liquid.
shots.narration: 压缩气体分三类。

shots.section_title: 液化气体：瓶里是液体
shots.scene: 气瓶剖面图：下半部是液体，上半部是气体
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a gas cylinder: liquid in the lower half and gas in the upper half. No people.
shots.narration: 液化气体加压后，在瓶里变成液体。

shots.section_title: 液化气体：瓶里是液体
shots.scene: 四只气瓶图标，挂着空白小标签
shots.prompt_en: Four cylinder icons in a row, each with a blank tag and a liquid level line. No people.
shots.narration: 比如氯气、二氧化碳、液化石油气。

shots.section_title: 非液化气体：始终是气体
shots.scene: 气瓶剖面图：里面充满气体小点，旁边温度计
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a cylinder filled only with gas dots, a thermometer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 非液化气体，不管温度如何都是气态。
overlay: 非液化气体：始终是气体

shots.section_title: 非液化气体：始终是气体
shots.scene: 三只气瓶图标，挂空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Three tall cylinder icons with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 比如氮气、氧气、氦气。

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 一只气瓶剖面，内部是海绵状填料浸着液体
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a cylinder packed with a porous sponge-like filler soaked in liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 溶解气体不稳定，要溶在溶剂里。
overlay: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶图标，旁边是丙酮瓶和多孔填料图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon with a flammable gas pictogram, next to a solvent bottle icon and a porous block icon. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是乙炔，瓶里有浸透丙酮的填料。

shots.section_title: 溶解气体：乙炔靠丙酮稳住
shots.scene: 填料把气体稳稳包住，爆炸图标被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: The porous filler holds the gas bubbles in place; an explosion icon outside is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 这样做，是为了防止爆炸。

shots.section_title: 气瓶必须标识清楚
shots.scene: 小研指着气瓶肩部的空白标签和危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank label and a hazard pictogram on a cylinder shoulder.
shots.narration: 气体不同，危害不同。

shots.section_title: 气瓶必须标识清楚
shots.scene: 没有标签的气瓶图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon with no label at all, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 所以气瓶一定要标识清楚。

shots.section_title: 气瓶分三种结构
shots.scene: 三种容器并排：细高气瓶、矮胖气瓶、低温罐
shots.prompt_en: Three containers side by side: a tall narrow cylinder, a short fat cylinder and a cryogenic dewar. No people.
shots.narration: 按气体种类和压力，气瓶有三种。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 细高的高压气瓶，剖面显示厚厚的瓶壁
shots.prompt_en: A tall narrow high-pressure cylinder with a cutaway showing a very thick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 高压气瓶细高，瓶壁很厚。
overlay: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 阿杰想单手拎起空气瓶，吃力得皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to lift an empty tall cylinder by its cap and grimaces at the weight.
shots.narration: 多用钢或铝做，空瓶也很重。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 压力表图标指针指向高处
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with the needle pointing far to the high side, next to a tall cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 能承受很高的压力。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶：细高、壁厚、很重
shots.scene: 一排高压气瓶，挂空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A row of tall high-pressure cylinders chained to a rack, each with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 常装氮、氦、氢、氧、二氧化碳。

shots.section_title: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
shots.scene: 矮胖的低压气瓶，剖面显示薄壁和焊缝
shots.prompt_en: A short fat low-pressure cylinder with a cutaway showing a thin wall and a welded seam line. No people.
shots.narration: 低压气瓶矮胖、较轻，壁薄有焊缝。
overlay: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝

shots.section_title: 低压气瓶：矮胖、壁薄、有焊缝
shots.scene: 压力表指针在较低位置，旁边是两个低压瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with the needle at a low position, next to two short fat cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 承压较低，常装液化石油气和制冷剂。

shots.section_title: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
shots.scene: 实验室角落的低温罐，顶部有阀门和泄压阀
shots.prompt_en: A cryogenic liquid dewar in a lab corner with valves and a pressure relief valve on top. No people.
shots.narration: 低温容器的工作压力相对较低。
overlay: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压

shots.section_title: 低温容器：靠泄压阀泄压
shots.scene: 温度计上升，泄压阀冒出白色气体
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rising while the relief valve on top of the dewar releases a small puff of white vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 温度升高，由泄压阀放掉多余压力。

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 老李用链条把气瓶固定在墙架上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens a chain around an upright cylinder on a wall-mounted bracket.
shots.narration: 不论哪种气瓶，都必须固定支撑。
overlay: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 墙装支架、链条、地面锚固三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a wall bracket, a chain and a floor anchor bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 可以用墙装支架、链条或锚固装置。

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 空瓶和满瓶都被同一个支架稳稳撑住
shots.prompt_en: An empty cylinder and a full cylinder both held firmly in the same rack. No people.
shots.narration: 要撑得住空瓶，也撑得住满瓶。

shots.section_title: 支架、链条，空瓶满瓶都撑住
shots.scene: 地上一排没固定的气瓶图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a row of loose cylinders standing on the floor without any restraint, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 随手立在地上，不行。

shots.section_title: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
shots.scene: 易燃和有毒气体的管路沿墙铺设，接到设备
shots.prompt_en: Gas lines run neatly along a lab wall from a gas cabinet to an instrument, with flame and skull pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、有毒气体的管路，
overlay: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规

shots.section_title: 易燃有毒气体管路要合规
shots.scene: 老李对照空白的规范文件检查管路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the gas lines against a blank standards document.
shots.narration: 必须符合国家标准和学校规定。

shots.section_title: 减压阀和压力表要配套
shots.scene: 减压阀和压力表接在气瓶上，旁边打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A pressure regulator with gauges correctly mounted on a cylinder valve, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 减压阀和压力表，要和气瓶配套。
overlay: 减压阀和压力表要配套

shots.section_title: 减压阀和压力表要配套
shots.scene: 减压阀被拿去接另一种气瓶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a regulator being moved onto a different kind of cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能拿去改用在别的气瓶上。

shots.section_title: 认识之后，才谈安全使用
shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐固定的气瓶架前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a neat, chained cylinder rack with a serious face.
shots.narration: 气体活泼，使用中危害很多。
overlay: 认识之后，才谈安全使用

shots.section_title: 认识之后，才谈安全使用
shots.scene: 王老师给学生讲解，身后空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 认清气体和气瓶，是安全用气的第一步。

shots.section_title: 乙炔瓶必须直立使用
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶直立固定在推车上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An acetylene-type cylinder stands upright and chained on a cart, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 乙炔瓶必须直立使用。

shots.section_title: 乙炔瓶必须直立使用
shots.scene: 卧倒的乙炔瓶图标被打叉，瓶口有液滴
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an acetylene-type cylinder lying on its side with liquid drops at the valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 卧放会让丙酮流出来，非常危险。

shots.section_title: 乙炔瓶必须直立使用
shots.scene: 老李把乙炔瓶扶正后静置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets a cylinder upright and steps back with an hourglass icon beside it.
shots.narration: 倒放过的，先直立静置再用。

shots.section_title: 气体管路标明名称和流向
shots.scene: 墙上的气体管路贴有空白标签和流向箭头
shots.prompt_en: Gas lines on a lab wall each carry a blank tag and a flow direction arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的气体管路，
overlay: 气体管路标明名称和流向

shots.section_title: 气体管路标明名称和流向
shots.scene: 管路上的标签和箭头被放大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gas line with a blank name tag and a clear flow arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 要标明气体名称和流向。

shots.section_title: 气体管路标明名称和流向
shots.scene: 老李在墙边安装管路，阿杰在旁边看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a gas line on the wall while the young male student watches from a distance.
shots.narration: 由专业人员安装，不私自改接。

shots.section_title: 用完先关瓶阀
shots.scene: 小研用完气后，先关气瓶总阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles, closes the main cylinder valve after finishing her work.
shots.narration: 用完气，先关气瓶上的总阀。

shots.section_title: 用完先关瓶阀
shots.scene: 压力表指针回落到零
shots.prompt_en: The regulator gauge needles drop back to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 再放掉管路余气，表针归零。

shots.section_title: 用完先关瓶阀
shots.scene: 只关减压阀、总阀开着的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder with its main valve still open and only the regulator closed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只关减压阀，不算关好。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三种气体图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating icons: a liquid drop, a gas cloud and dissolved bubbles.
shots.narration: 液化、非液化、溶解，三类气体。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 高压瓶、低压瓶、低温罐三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tall cylinder, a short fat cylinder and a cryogenic dewar. No people.
shots.narration: 高压、低压、低温，三种容器。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 带标签、链条固定、配套减压阀的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A labeled cylinder chained to a rack with a matching regulator, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标识清楚、固定牢靠、阀表配套。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 直立的乙炔瓶和关紧的瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: An upright acetylene-type cylinder and a closed cylinder valve, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 乙炔瓶直立，用完先关瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在气瓶架旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy, chained gas cylinder rack.
shots.narration: 认清气瓶，安全用气，下次见！
